audience.description: Busy working adults who want skin that feels comfortable without a ten step routine. They keep a short bathroom shelf, value plain ingredients and fair prices, and like products that fit into a rushed morning and a tired night. They trust simple, honest explanations over hype.

brief.productRole: The jar is opened on a bathroom counter and a pea-sized scoop of glossy gel-cream is taken with a fingertip. It is pressed onto cheeks and forehead and blended in within seconds as the skin visibly goes from slightly dull to soft and dewy. In a second beat, the same cream goes on before a quick makeup step in a morning rush, then the lid is clicked closed and the jar is dropped back on a shelf next to a toothbrush cup.
brief.mood: Calm, unfussy, quietly satisfying, a small easy win in a busy day

music.style: Warm lo-fi indie pop with soft finger-picked electric guitar, muted drum machine, gentle bass and a light airy synth pad, modern bedroom-recorded feel

visual.look: Soft natural window light, clean neutral grade with warm highlights and gentle contrast, fine film grain. Handheld 35mm-style framing at close and medium distances, with macro inserts on the gel texture and the fingertip scoop. Quick but unhurried pacing: about six cuts, each 2 to 3 seconds, with a satisfying texture close-up at the 5 second mark and a clean product hero on a shelf at the end. Vertical framing keeps the face and jar in the center safe zone.

wardrobe.styling: Relaxed everyday basics in muted tones: an oatmeal knit sweater, a plain white tee, a soft gray robe, hair pulled back with a plain clip or towel headband. No logos, no printed text, minimal jewelry.

types: bright small apartment bathroom with a white tile counter
tidy bedroom vanity corner by a window
entryway shelf with keys and a tote bag

voice.tone: Plain, warm and a little dry, like a friend who respects your time
use: Names the two key ingredients, glycerin and squalane, in simple words
Says it is light, unscented and sinks in fast
Mentions it works alone or under makeup
States clearly that it is a daily moisturizer without sunscreen
Ends with the price of $32 and one simple call to action
avoid: Talking like a customer who tried it
Long routines or step counts beyond one

hooks: Your skincare routine just got one step.

talent.description: One fictional adult woman in her early thirties with a relaxed, natural look and tied-back hair, shown getting ready in a hurry but unbothered. A second fictional adult, a man in his late thirties, appears briefly in the background of the entryway scene grabbing keys.
